SELECT p.`name` mec_name, p.phone mec_phone, p.contact_number mec_contact_number, c.id, c.create_time, sri.role_names FROM bd_campus_connection c LEFT JOIN bd_mec_personnel p ON c.mec_personnel_id = p.id
JOIN
LEFT JOIN
( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( sr.role_name ) role_names, sur.user_id FROM sys_user_role sur JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.role_id WHERE campus_id = #{campusId} AND mec_id = #{mecId} AND user_type = 1 AND status = 0
and sr.role_id = #{roleId}
GROUP BY sur.user_id # 通过登录人员关联权限表 ) sri ON sri.user_id = c.id WHERE c.campus_id = #{campusId} AND p.mec_id = #{mecId} AND c.is_delete = 0 AND p.is_delete = 0
AND phone like concat('%', #{mecPhone}, '%')

SELECT con.id, con.mec_id, con.mec_personnel_id, con.campus_id, con.create_by, con.create_time, con.update_by, con.update_time, con.is_delete, cam.`name` campus_name FROM bd_campus_connection con LEFT JOIN bd_campus cam ON con.campus_id = cam.id WHERE con.mec_personnel_id = #{mecPersonnelId} AND con.is_delete = 0
